title: Evaluate the real-human arXiv demo of the reusable flywheel
description:
## Scope
Companion to core milestone decision-flywheel-e1e92986-a121-410a-b8c2-fb467d6b3d88. Real human labels and explanations, not a simulated labeler; dataset preparation, application integration and study measurement belong here. Core orchestration belongs in Decision-Flywheel. Prior completed simulated studies remain historical evidence, not proof this application is connected.

## Acceptance
Pinned source manifest; predeclared training/development/random-audit/permanent-scoreboard roles; functional reviewer consuming public core APIs; reproducible alignment-versus-label-effort report with actual optimizer/fit events and model usage. Start at full review; lower review rate only under a declared random-audit confidence rule. No live calls merely because a key exists. New study caps require explicit approval; do not reuse historical approval as blanket authorization.
